## Summary

**FMOVEM** (Move muliple float registers from/to memory).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `list → <ea>` |
| Syntax | `FMOVEM <list>,<ea>`<br>`FMOVEM <ea>,<list>` |
| Description | Fmovem on the 68080 is the same as previous generations, except for the fact that the format in memory is a tiny bit different. For calculated results it makes no difference when a push and later a pull is done. To get all the bits of the float you need a fmove.d fpn,&lt;ea&gt; Programs that use the expected extended layout in memory may be affected. |
| FP condition codes | not affected |

### Memory formats

Motorola eXtende format:

| Long word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 31 | S |
| 1 | 30–16 | E (15 bits) |
| 1 | 15–0 | (empty in the original) |
| 2 | 31 | M |
| 2 | 30–0 | boxes numbered 1–31 |
| 3 | 31–0 | boxes numbered 32–63 |

Apollo eXtende format:

| Long word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 31 | S |
| 1 | 30–16 | E (15 bits) |
| 1 | 15–0 | boxes numbered 32–47 |
| 2 | 31 | M |
| 2 | 30–0 | boxes numbered 1–31 |
| 3 | 31–0 | (empty in the original) |

Double format:

| Long word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 31 | S |
| 1 | 30–20 | E (11 bits) |
| 1 | 19–0 | boxes numbered 1–20 |
| 2 | 31–0 | boxes numbered 21–52 |

### Notes

- Newer cores will use the 'normal' eXtended format.

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have FMOVEM. This page covers only the 68080 addition: a different extended format layout in memory. For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.
- The 68080 stores extended precision in memory in its own layout (see the formats above). Code that reads the stored bytes directly may be affected.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T depend on the Motorola extended layout in memory: the 68080 layout differs. Use FMOVE.D to get all bits of a value.
